editorial.blurb: A warmhearted family-owned Roman trattoria where owner Letizia and her family craft everything from scratch, from housemade pasta to polenta passed down from Rome.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early on Friday nights to secure a table, and ask for Hector—the staff goes out of their way to make occasions special, and don't miss the bruschetta flight and spritz flight if you're planning to return.
